notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: one wide left-side drawer, two separately manipulated upper-cabinet doors, and one right-side drawer. The two upper-cabinet closing actions occur within the same short sampled interval, so their individual off midpoints are approximate.
scene_description: A user moves around a narrow residential kitchen and manipulates drawers and the two hinged doors of an upper cabinet above the stove.
